design.attestation: The provider computes a policy digest, records container ID/image digest/configuration, verifies Docker inspect state before and after execution, validates source hash and output bounds, and uses the host capability to attest controls and cleanup.
design.handoff: After T003, resume the parent release-evidence plan at T003/T004-equivalent sandbox and assurance work, preserving the parent receipt/state authority.
design.injection: The required probe and positive integration harness receive the provider through an explicit host-owned entrypoint; the default probe remains unavailable when no provider is supplied.
design.provider: A dedicated Docker provider launches one disposable non-privileged container per candidate from a pinned digest, using network=none, read-only rootfs, bounded tmpfs/workspace, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, explicit CPU/memory/PID/output limits, and an explicit environment allowlist.
design.recovery: Container timeout/cancellation/crash triggers bounded descendant/container cleanup; inability to prove quiescence returns UNKNOWN and blocks retry.

discoveredRequirements.requirement: Use a pinned image digest and record Docker inspect output sufficient to bind the actual container to the attestation.
